description:
intent=i038 snapshot=s10 branch=media-epidx status=complete
finding location=drivers/media/usb/usbvision/usbvision-video.c:1493-1510 confidence=high conclusion=usbvision probe loops all altsettings of interface[0] reading endpoint[1].wMaxPacketSize into alt_max_pkt_size[] with only altsetting[0] of a possibly different interface validated, giving OOB read of descriptor memory at plug-in.
finding location=drivers/media/usb/b2c2/flexcop-usb.c:427-433 confidence=high conclusion=flexcop-usb transfer_init reads cur_altsetting->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize at probe with no bNumEndpoints check anywhere in the driver; OOB descriptor read directly sizes the isoc URB buffer and frame lengths.
finding location=drivers/media/usb/gspca/stv06xx/stv06xx.c:314-345 confidence=high conclusion=gspca stv06xx isoc_init/isoc_nego index intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1].endpoint[0] with no num_altsetting or bNumEndpoints validation at stream start, enabling OOB write/read of the cached descriptor array.
finding location=drivers/media/usb/gspca/xirlink_cit.c:2634-2690 confidence=high conclusion=gspca xirlink_cit sd_isoc_init/sd_isoc_nego write and read intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1].endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize with no num_altsetting/bNumEndpoints check, OOB access into the device-supplied config cache at stream start.
finding location=drivers/media/usb/gspca/stv06xx/stv06xx.c:279-295 confidence=medium conclusion=gspca stv06xx_start reads usb_altnum_to_altsetting(...)->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize at stream start without any bNumEndpoints check, OOB descriptor read whose value programs the STV_ISO_SIZE_L bridge register.
finding location=drivers/media/usb/gspca/stv06xx/stv06xx_pb0100.c:188-198 confidence=medium conclusion=gspca pb0100_start reads alt->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize after only a NULL-altsetting check, no bNumEndpoints validation, OOB descriptor read feeding sensor configuration.
finding location=drivers/media/usb/gspca/ov519.c:3455-3473 confidence=medium conclusion=gspca ov511_mode_init_regs reads alt->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize with no bNumEndpoints or endpoint-type validation at stream start and programs it into the bridge FIFO packet-size register.
finding location=drivers/media/usb/gspca/ov519.c:3581-3599 confidence=medium conclusion=gspca ov518_mode_init_regs reads alt->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize with no bNumEndpoints check and feeds the OOB-read value into the OV518 FIFO packet-size bridge registers.
finding location=drivers/media/usb/gspca/xirlink_cit.c:1444-1455 confidence=medium conclusion=gspca xirlink_cit cit_get_packet_size returns alt->endpoint[0].desc.wMaxPacketSize with only a NULL-altsetting check, OOB descriptor read used in clock-divisor/bandwidth calculations.
finding location=drivers/media/usb/siano/smsusb.c:423-444 confidence=medium conclusion=smsusb_init_device dereferences udev->ep_in[1]->desc.wMaxPacketSize at probe without checking that the device declared an IN endpoint 1, NULL-deref on a descriptor-malformed Siano-spoofing gadget.
unresolved location=drivers/media/usb/gspca/gspca.c:910 conclusion=Follow up: determine whether alt_xfer() can return NULL at the create_urbs call site (e.g. after isoc_nego patches wMaxPacketSize to 0 in the cached vs live altsetting copies) making create_urbs NULL-deref ep->desc.wMaxPacketSize.
coverage_gap=Downstream propagation of the OOB-read wMaxPacketSize values (usbvision alt_max_pkt_size[], flexcop frame_size/bufsize, gspca create_urbs psize) into URB completion handlers' copy offsets and buffer-write bounds was not audited beyond the sizing sites named in the findings.
coverage_gap=The gspca core create_urbs/alt_xfer NULL-deref question (gspca.c:910) was left unresolved as no more targeted reads were permitted; it needs a data-flow check of isoc_nego's wMaxPacketSize patching versus the live vs cached altsetting arrays.
